color-border-default.$description: Audit: #D7DEE7/#DDE5EC/#E3E8EE cluster, 880 raw uses — single largest border cluster, default card/input border. Re-aliased from color/gray/300 (placeholder) to new color/slate/300 primitive to match actual raw hue family.

color-border-strong.$description: Audit: #C8D2DD, 75 raw uses — higher-contrast borders (active/selected states, table dividers on dense Back Office views). Re-aliased from color/gray/500 to color/slate/500.

color-border-focus.$description: Audit: #1D4ED8, 112 raw uses (dominant blue border/outline color) — closely matches color/blue/700 (#1D44BA), not blue/500 as previously placeholder-aliased. Re-aliased.

color-primary-light.$description: Brand actions — primary buttons, links, focus states. Use light for tinted backgrounds, default for solid fills/icons, foreground for text on light or transparent background.

color-primary-default.$description: Brand actions — primary buttons, links, focus states. Use light for tinted backgrounds, default for solid fills/icons, foreground for text on light or transparent background.

color-primary-foreground.$description: Brand actions — primary buttons, links, focus states. Use light for tinted backgrounds, default for solid fills/icons, foreground for text on light or transparent background.

color-negative-light.$description: Errors, destructive actions, critical validation states.

color-negative-default.$description: Errors, destructive actions, critical validation states.

color-negative-foreground.$description: Errors, destructive actions, critical validation states.

color-positive-light.$description: Success confirmations, completed states, positive metrics.

color-positive-default.$description: Success confirmations, completed states, positive metrics.

color-positive-foreground.$description: Success confirmations, completed states, positive metrics.

color-warning-light.$description: Caution states — pending review, approaching limits, non-blocking issues.

color-warning-default.$description: Caution states — pending review, approaching limits, non-blocking issues.

color-warning-foreground.$description: Caution states — pending review, approaching limits, non-blocking issues.

color-neutral-light.$description: Default UI chrome — secondary buttons, borders, disabled/inactive elements.

color-neutral-default.$description: Default UI chrome — secondary buttons, borders, disabled/inactive elements.

color-neutral-foreground.$description: Default UI chrome — secondary buttons, borders, disabled/inactive elements.

color-bg-overlay.$description: Scrim for modals/loading shimmer. Apply at 40% layer opacity — Figma variables don't carry alpha in fills, so set opacity on the node.

color-state-disabled-bg.$description: Background fill for any disabled interactive element.

color-primary-hover.$description: Hover state for primary interactive fills — one step darker than /default.

color-negative-hover.$description: Hover state for negative interactive fills — one step darker than /default.

color-positive-hover.$description: Hover state for positive interactive fills — one step darker than /default.

color-warning-hover.$description: Hover state for warning interactive fills — one step darker than /default.

color-neutral-hover.$description: Hover state for neutral interactive fills — one step darker than /default.

color-shadow-base.$description: Base color all elevation/shadow effect styles derive from, at reduced opacity per level.

color-border-subtle.$description: Audit: #EEF1F5/#EAEFF4/#E8ECF1/#E4E9EF cluster, 515 raw uses (Web+App+BackOffice) — lightest divider/separator borders.

color-border-negative.$description: Audit: #F2C2BD light-red cluster, 32 raw uses (error banners/inputs) + #E02B2B/#C1362F strong-red, 6 raw uses. Aliased to red/300 as nearest primitive match.

color-border-warning.$description: Audit: #F0D9A8, 30 raw uses (warning banners/badges, mostly Back Office). Aliased to amber/300 as nearest primitive match.

color-border-positive.$description: Audit: #BFE3CD, 7 raw uses (success banners) — thin evidence, included for parity with existing status-color set. Aliased to green/200 as nearest primitive match.
